 (AS)

G2006.definition:

 [in LXX:  1Ch.28:2 ,  Wis.4:5 ,  1Ma.4:46 , al. ;]

G2008.definition:

G2009.definition:
ἐπιτιμία , -ας, ἡ 
 (ἐπιτιμάω), [in LXX: Wis_3:10 * ;] 
__1. citizenship, franchise. 
 __2. As in Inscr. (LS, see word), LXX, l.with (= cl. τὸ ἐπιτίμιον),  punishment, penalty :  2Co.2:6. †
 (AS)

G2010.definition:
ἐπι-τρέπω  
 [in LXX (usually with seel. ἐπιστρ-):  Gen.39:6  (עָזַב), etc. ;]

 __2.  to yield, permit :  1Co.16:7 ,  Heb.6:3 ; with dative of person(s),  Mrk.5:13 ,  Jhn.19:38 ; id. with inf. (cf. M,  Pr. , 205),  Mat.8:21 19:8 ,  Luk.8:32 9:52, 61   Act.21:39-40 27:3 ,  1Ti.2:12 ; with inf.,  Mrk.10:4.  Pass., with dative and inf.,  Act.26:1 28:16 ,  1Co.14:34 .†

G2011.definition:
ἐπι-τροπή , -ῆς, ἡ

 power to decide, authority :  Act.26:12. †

G2012.definition:
ἐπίτροπος , -ου, ὁ
 (ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX:  2Ma.11:1   2Mac 13:2   2Mac 14:2  * ;] 
__1.  an administrator, a steward :  Mat.20:3 ,  Luk.8:3 . 
 __2.  a guardian  (with genitive of person(s), 2Mac, ll. with):  Gal.4:2. †
 (AS)

G2013.definition:
ἐπι-τυγχάνω  
 [in LXX:  Gen.39:2  (צָלַח hi.),  Pro.12:27  (חָרַךְ)* ;] 
__1. to light upon. 
 __2.  to obtain, attain to :  Jas.4:2 , with genitive of thing(s) (as in cl.),  Heb.6:15 11:33 ; with accusative (late Gk.),  Rom.11:7  (Rec. τούτου).†
 (AS)

G2014.definition:
ἐπι-φαίνω  
 [in LXX for עוּר hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to show forth. 
 __2. (= pass. in cl.) to appear:  Act.27:20;  with dative of person(s),  Luk.1:79;  metaphorically,  Tit.3:4;  with dative,  Tit.2:11  (Cremer, 567).†
 (AS)

G2015.definition:

G2016.definition:
ἐπιφανής , -ές
 (ἐπιφαίνω), [in LXX (see Thayer, see word) for יָרֵא, etc.,  Jdg.13:6 ,  Jol.2:11, 31  al.;  2Ma.6:23 ,  3Ma.5:35 , al. ;]

G2019.definition:
ἐπι-φωνέω , -ῶ

 (AS)

G2020.definition:
ἐπι-φώσκω  
 [in LXX for הָלַל hi.,  Job.41:18  A (Βא, ἐπιφαύσκ-) * ;] 
__1. to let shine. 
 __2.  to dawn  (cf. MM,  Exp. , xiv):  Luk.23:54;  before εἰς, Mat_28:1.†
 (AS)

G2021.definition:
ἐπιχειρέω , -ῶ
 (χεῖρ), [in LXX for חָשַׁב,  Exo.9:25;  גָּמַל,  2Ch.20:11 , al. ;] 
__1. to pat one's hand to. 
 __2.  to take in hand, attempt : with inf.,  Luk.1:1 ,  Act.9:29 19:13 .†
 (AS)

G2022.definition:

 [in LXX chiefly for יָצַק.  Gen.28:18 , al. ;]

G2023.definition:
ἐπι-χορηγέω , -ῶ 
 [in LXX:  Sir.25:22 ,  2Ma.4:9  A * ;] 
 to supply, provide : with accusative of thing(s),  2Pe.1:5;  id. with dative of person(s),  2Co.9:10 ,  Gal.3:5 ; pass.,  Col.2:19 ,  2Pe.1:11  (cf. χορηγέω, and see MM,  Exp. , xiv).†

ἐργάζομαι 
 (ἔργον), [in LXX for עָבַד, פָּעַל, עָשָׂה, etc. ;] 
__1. intrans., 
 __(a)  to work, labour :  Mat.21:28 ,  Luk.13:14 ,  Jhn.5:17 9:4  b,  Act.18:3 ,  1Co.9:6 ,  2Th.3:10-12 ; τ. χερσίν,  1Co.4:12 ,  1Th.4:11 ; νυκτὸς κ. ἡαέρας,  1Th.2:9 ,  2Th.3:8 ; of working for pay,  Mat.21:28;  for reward,  Rom.4:4-5;  
 __(b)  to work at a trade or business, to trade : before Iv (Dem.),  Mat.25:16.  
 __2. Trans., 
 __(a)  to work, work out, do, produce, perform : with accusative,  2Co.7:10 ,  Col.3:23 ,  2Th.3:11 ,  Jas.1:20 ,  2Jn.8 , before εἰς,  III Jn 5 ; ἔργον,  Act.13:41  (LXX); id. before εἰς,  Mat.26:10;  ἐν,  Mrk.14:6;  ἔργα,  Jhn.3:21;  τὰ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ,  Jhn.6:28 9:4 ; τὸ ἔ. κυρίου,  1Co.16:10;  τ. ἀγαθόν,  Rom.2:10 ,  Eph.4:28  (see AR,  Eph. ) 190); id. before πρός,  Gal.6:10;  κακόν, before dative of person(s) (more frequently dupl. accusative, in cl.),  Rom.13:10;  δικαιοσύνην,  Act.10:35 ,  Heb.11:33 ; ἀνομίαν,  Mat.7:23;  ἁμαρτίαν,  Jas.2:9;  σημεῖον,  Jhn.6:30;  τ. ἱερά,  1Co.9:13;  τ. θάλασσαν (work the sea, i.e. make one's living from it),  Rev.18:17;  
 __(b)  to work for, earn by working  (cl.):  Jhn.6:27  (cf. κατ-, περι-, προσ-εργάζομαι; Cremer, 258; on the force of the aorist of this verb, see M,  Pr. , 116).†
 (AS)

 __2.  working, performance :  Eph.4:19. †
 (AS)

 (ἐργάζομαι, which see), [in LXX:  Wis.17:17 ,  Sir.19:1 40:18 ,  1Ma.3:6  * ;]

(as frequently in cl.),  Mat.5:16 ,  1Ti.5:10, 25   Heb.10:24 ; ἔ. πίστεως,  1Th.1:3 ,  2Th.1:11 ; ἔ. πονηρά,  Col.1:21 ,  2Jo.11 ; νέκρα,  Heb.6:1 9:14 ; ἄκαρπα,  Eph.5:11;  ἔ. ἀσεβείας,  Ju 15 ; τ. σκότους,  Rom.13:12 ,  Eph.5:11 ; ἔ. νόμου,  Rom.3:20, 28   Gal.2:16 3:2, 5 10 .
